resources.string: Raw output. You only need this to find out why something failed.
Phones on the same Wi-Fi that are lending their memory show up here by themselves.
Start sharing on another phone, or add one by its address.
Start sharing on your other phones (Distributed, then Helper device).
Find them below, or add them by address.
Choose a model and tap Start.
Phones that lend their memory to this phone, the main device (master).
Choose what to run. The app reads the model first so it knows how to split it.
For models that can look at pictures, pick the matching vision file.
The vision file always runs on this phone, never on a helper.
Decide which devices hold the model and how much of this phone\'s memory it may use.
Waiting for the model check to finish.
Spread it over several devices, or keep it whole on one device.
How much of this phone\'s memory the model may use. Leave some free for Android and your other apps.
Optional. The defaults work for most models.
Every extra device adds a network round trip for each word generated, so fewer devices is usually faster.
Memory to keep free per device

Keeps some memory free on each device so Android does not close the app. One number applies to every device; separate numbers with commas to set each device (this phone first, then the helpers in order). The layers field forces a layer count.
A small draft model or a word-pattern guess runs ahead and the main model checks it, which can speed up replies.
How much text the model remembers, how random its replies are, and how work is split across processor threads.
The model\'s short-term memory of the chat (KV cache). Smaller types use less RAM but can lose a little quality.
The port other apps use to reach the model, and whether other devices on your network may connect to it.
For experts: flags passed to the model server, a command template, and saved commands.
Starting the model server and connecting to your helpers.
Sending the model to your helpers. Helpers that already have it cached start faster.
The model is ready on port %1$d.
Tap Start when you are ready.
